title: The Penalty Night on Long Stays and Package Plans — Room Reservations
content:
**Clause.** For the penalty a late cancellation of a Room Reservations reservation owes, the penalty night is set by the length of the stay and the kind of plan. For a stay of at least 7 nights the penalty night is the long-stay share, 15%, of the whole stay at the nightly rate; for a stay shorter than that on a package plan the penalty night is one night at the nightly rate less the package supplement, the package's inclusions not being served; any other stay keeps the penalty night the plan's basis gives.

**Terms.**

- *Whole stay at the nightly rate* — the nights of the stay, from the arrival date to the departure date, multiplied by the nightly rate on the reservation.
- *Package plan* — a plan whose rate includes breakfast and carries a package supplement; among the Room Reservations rate plans, the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate.
- *Package supplement* — the plan's package supplement per night.

**Judgement.**

| Stay | Package plan? | Penalty night |
|---|---|---|
| 7 nights or more | either | 15% multiplied by the nights multiplied by the nightly rate |
| 6 nights or fewer | yes | one night at the nightly rate less the package supplement |
| 6 nights or fewer | no | the penalty night the plan's basis gives |

A stay of 7 nights or more takes the long-stay penalty night whatever the plan's basis, a full-stay basis included.

**Cases (hypothetical reservations).**

- Flexible Rate, 8 nights at 200.00: 15% of 8 nights at 200.00, that is 15% of 1,600.00, is 240.00.
- Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, 10 nights at 180.00: 15% of 1,800.00 is 270.00.
- Bed & Breakfast Package Rate, 3 nights at 242.00 with a 32.00 supplement: 242.00 less 32.00 is 210.00.
- Semi-Flexible Saver Rate, 3 nights: the penalty night the plan's basis gives.
